_comment: Shared by tests/HeightCascadeTest.php and tests/js/height-cascade.test.ts. optional_height() and optionalHeight() must agree on every one of these, including the inputs where PHP's is_numeric() and JavaScript's Number() disagree. JSON cannot encode NaN or Infinity, so those are written as the markers "__NAN__", "__INF__" and "__NEG_INF__"; each side turns them into its own non-finite value before calling.
